title: Select evidence for the shown revision
responsibility: Builds the evidence request for an entity at the displayed revision, distinguishing a branch view from a specifically selected commit.

inputs.name: evidenceQuery.view
inputs.description: The displayed snapshot, whether the address pins a commit, and the optional project identity. Pinning remains true even when the selected commit happens to be the branch tip.

inputs.name: evidenceQuery.entityId
inputs.description: The entity identity to include unchanged in the request.

outputs.name: evidenceQuery
outputs.description: A request with the entity, displayed commit and branch, and project context; null when no snapshot revision is available. A pinned view uses commit mode, which asks for comparison with the first parent. An unpinned view uses current mode for the shown branch view.
